originalTitle: Implosion of Situational Awareness hedge fund has Wall Street betting the bottom is in for the AI trade
summary: One of the wildest months in recent memory for the U.S. stock market is ending on yet another remarkable note: A highflying hedge fund run by an AI wunderkind in his mid-20s has apparently just been carried out on a stretcher.
